title: Consent and purpose checks
acceptance_scenarios: Witness grant, missing consent, withdrawal and queued/offline replay across backend, FHIR, PWA, AI and marketing. Verify permissible other-lawful-basis processing remains available.
evidence_after_implementation: A01-consent-exhibit.pdf; A01-purpose-cases.csv; A01-enforcement-results.json; tenant-configuration.json. Include notice version, exact event times and test identities.
manual_acceptance: Approve purpose/legal-basis map and consent wording. Reviewer checks every enabled path and tenant/template. Refresh when purposes, notices, callers or enforcement settings change.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Consent records capture exact notice/version, actor and event time. Purpose lookup includes AI, support, analytics, training and audio recording. Immutable selected recipients bind AI transmission. Photo/audio upload gates run before storage. PWA and backend expose notice/recipient controls.
remaining_actions: Approve notices, representative authority and lawful exceptions; arrange actual provider destinations before AI/speech use.
